# Breezy HR

> Breezy HR is a modern applicant tracking system and HR platform that combines AI-powered candidate screening, recruitment automation, performance management, and employee onboarding into a unified hiring and talent management solution.

Breezy HR provides end-to-end recruitment and HR capabilities for growing teams, from job posting and candidate screening through onboarding and performance management. The platform integrates with major job boards, HRIS systems, and collaboration tools like Slack to streamline the entire hiring lifecycle.

## Key Topics

- Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- AI-Powered Candidate Screening
- Resume Screening & Fraud Detection
- Candidate Management
- Job Advertising & Distribution
- Employee Referrals
- Interview Tools & Scheduling
- Offer Management
- HRIS Integration
- Compliance Tracking (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP)
- Recruiting Analytics & Reporting
- Performance Management
- Employee Onboarding
- Hiring Automation
- Diversity & Inclusion

## Core Platform

- [Breezy HR Homepage](https://breezy.hr): ATS platform for attracting, screening, and hiring quality employees
- [Breezy Intelligence](https://breezy.hr/p/breezy-intelligence): AI-powered candidate screening, resume fraud detection, and interview summarization

## Attract Candidates

- [Attract: Multi-Channel Job Posting](https://breezy.hr/attract): Job posting to 50+ boards, career portals, and multi-channel recruitment features
- [Career Sites](https://breezy.hr/attract/career-sites): Career site builder for attracting candidates via branded job portals
- [Job Advertising](https://breezy.hr/attract/advertise-jobs): Job advertising distribution across Indeed, LinkedIn, Ziprecruiter, and more
- [Employee Referrals](https://breezy.hr/attract/employee-referrals): Employee referral program and recruiting automation features

## Qualify & Screen Candidates

- [Qualify: Candidate Screening & ATS](https://breezy.hr/qualify): Candidate screening, AI scoring, and applicant tracking system features
- [Candidate Management](https://breezy.hr/qualify/candidate-management): Candidate management, pipeline tracking, and resume screening tools
- [Automations](https://breezy.hr/qualify/automations): Automated workflows, AI scoring, and candidate communication automation
- [Interview Tools](https://breezy.hr/qualify/interview-tools): Interview scheduling, candidate evaluation, and team collaboration tools
- [Team Collaboration](https://breezy.hr/qualify/collaboration): Team collaboration, Slack integration, and collaborative hiring tools

## Hire & Onboard

- [Hire: Offer Management & Compliance](https://breezy.hr/hire): Offer management, compliance tracking, and HRIS integration features
- [Offer Management](https://breezy.hr/hire/offers): Offer management and approval automation for hiring teams
- [HRIS Integrations](https://breezy.hr/hire/hris-integrations): HRIS integration for seamless onboarding and employee data management
- [Compliance Tracking](https://breezy.hr/hire/compliance): GDPR, EEOC, and OFCCP compliance tracking and reporting features
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://breezy.hr/hire/reporting-analytics): Recruiting analytics, hiring metrics, and performance reporting
- [Breezy Onboard](https://breezy.hr/onboard): Streamlined paperwork, goal tracking, and new hire productivity

## Performance Management

- [Breezy Perform](https://breezy.hr/perform): Performance reviews, goal tracking, and employee engagement tool
- [Perform Features](https://breezy.hr/perform/features): Performance reviews, goal tracking, feedback, and 1:1 conversation features

## Resources & Learning

- [Hire Learning Blog](https://breezy.hr/hire-learning): Recruiting best practices, DEI guides, candidate experience, and HR resources
